def test_preview_unauthorized(self):
        """Test preview requires authentication"""
        response = self.client.get(f'/api/v1/marketplace/listings/{self.listing.id}/preview/')
        
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED)

"""Test preview includes expiration timestamp"""
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.user)
        
        response = self.client.get(f'/api/v1/marketplace/listings/{self.listing.id}/preview/')
        
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_200_OK)
        self.assertIn('preview_expires_at', response.data)

)
        
        # Filter by domain
        response = self.client.get('/api/v1/marketplace/listings/search/?domain=sales')
        
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_200_OK)
        self.assertEqual(response.data['count'], 1)

self.assertEqual(response.data['results'][0]['domain'], 'sales')
        
        # Filter by tags
        response = self.client.get('/api/v1/marketplace/listings/search/?tags=orders')
        
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_200_OK)
        self.assertEqual(response.data['count'], 1)

self.client.force_login(self.user)
        
        # Test 404 for non-existent resource
        response = self.client.get("/api/v1/contracts/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/")
        self.assertIn(response.status_code, [404, 401, 403])
